invariants: force and torque share the declared origin
mass, Maxwell, and photon momentum are not duplicated
periodic samples share mesh and solver identity
vector field divergence residual is bounded

lowering.openfoam: map face and volume fields to OpenFOAM boundary/field dictionaries and function objects
lowering.elmer: map geometry and material fields to Elmer sif equations and solver outputs
lowering.su2: map compressible fluid/species fields and surface flux outputs to SU2 configuration and history data
lowering.precice: map exchanged interface fields and convergence residuals to preCICE coupling data
lowering.custom: implement the IR operators directly while preserving packet identity and invariants

admission.screening: packet may be numerically evaluated but physicalAdmission remains false
admission.physical: requires solver identity, mesh convergence, independent energy/entropy closure, and declared evidence authority
admission.failure: missing fields or invariant violations produce a refusal record, never an inferred value
